categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Changes core PSBT logic in src/psbt.cpp rather than RPC dispatch, parsing, or server machinery; tests under rpc_psbt.py only exercise the underlying PSBT behavior.
categories.rationale: Not an RPC change under category guidelines: the behavior an RPC merely exposes belongs to its functional area (PSBT/wallet).

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Tagged PSBT and modifies SignPSBTInput in src/psbt.cpp, which governs PSBT handling and signing in the wallet domain.
categories.rationale: Fixes an interoperability bug where valid Taproot PSBTs fail to sign or finalize when PSBT_IN_SIGHASH_TYPE is absent. As noted in issue #36507 and BIP 371/341, 65-byte explicit sighash signatures were erroneously rejected with SIGHASH_MISMATCH, blocking valid multisig inputs.
